PFAFF: Indicating disapproval, scoffery, irritation, impatience or disbelief.
PFENNIG: One hundredth of the former German mark (Deutsche Mark).
PFFT: Used to signify a sudden ending or disappearance.
PFUI: an exclamation indicating disagreement or rejection of an argument; contempt
PFUND: A pound (unit of weight), in German contexts.
PFUNK: A style of funk music associated with the Parliament-Funkadelic collective in the 1970s and early 1980s.
